decision: done means no beveled corners, 20px cards and 12px small controls, soft focus, and screenshots of every key surface

decision: kept a 12px radius for controls about 40px tall

decision: left queue filters, role tags, and Ask suggestion chips as pills
why: they were already pills, and a short chip at 20px radius is the same shape

decision: left day squares, legend swatches, and score blocks on a tight radius
why: those are data marks, and a 12px radius turns a small square into a dot

decision: local home search shell and Analyze button compute to 20px, settings link to 12px, corner-shape is not bevel
